anomalies.observed: Both MCP2515 controllers have SI connected to CAN_CIPO and SO connected to CAN_COPI.
anomalies.expected: The controller-output net CAN_COPI should connect to each MCP2515's SI input, and CAN_CIPO should connect to its SO output.

evidence.quote: U8 pin 14 SI: CAN_CIPO; pin 15 SO: CAN_COPI. The same mapping appears at U9. (CAN BUS area, sheet / page 1)
COPI "Controller Out, Peripheral In"; CIPO "Controller In, Peripheral Out". (SPI Naming Note, sheet / page 1)

anomalies.impact: The SPI transmit and receive paths are crossed for both CAN controllers, so the CM4 is unlikely to communicate with either MCP2515; both CAN interfaces may be unusable.

parsed.summary: Both MCP2515s have their SPI SI and SO pins connected to the opposite controller-direction nets. The schematic’s own SPI naming note confirms that the CAN_COPI and CAN_CIPO connections are reversed.
